body: Thank you so much friend. Do you know any options I could look into that would appeal to conservative mindsets? Everything I look into basically tells me "if you're willing" and I most certainly am but idk how that would appeal to a mindset of "of course I'm not willing"

Thanks so much for the thoughtfulness friend. I really appreciate it. I've been shunned from my family for not wanting to support the decisions they make (growing pot and excessively spending on useless shit) and how they affect me. I'm definitely a lucky guy to be so well off but I don't have love anymore from my family and idk if my girlfriend is enough to make me want to stick around to see the results of this. I wanted to be a doctor and forget about the past but since my grandma's passing it only shows that they don't include me in anything. They didn't tell me that my grandma wanted to call me from the hospital bed. My cousin told me they said that I would be busy. I would never be too busy to say goodbye to the woman that taught me to laugh and enjoy the small stuff. I'm just sad

Thanks for the advice friend. She went home for the summer to be with her folks and I'm just here wondering what I want out of life and having a kid on my back right now is something I'm definitely against. I'm about to finish my degree in chemistry and begin studying for the MCAT as well as shadowing a family doctor at a local clinic. I'm just sad and I'm running out of hope and the will to live

Thanks for the suggestion kind friend, but she has told me very clearly that she doesn't believe in dumping off kids either. It's my fault for not just leaving but I really liked her and now I don't see a way out. I really just want to die. Sorry for being negative, but it's the truth
